newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: European feeds start mixed but quiet.
newsitem.headline: European feeds start mixed but quiet.

text.p: European feeds started mixed on Friday with nearby soymeal positions starting a little firmer but values further out dropping in line with Chicago's close.
Traders said there was no business in early dealings, with the continued strength of the dollar hampering activity and irratic movements in Chicago futures making life more difficult.
"It's impossible to get a clear picture of what's going on," one trader said, noting that bullish export data from the United States yesterday still left new crop positions off by the close.
August CBOT soybeans closed sharply up on talk of increased demand for old-crop. -- Amsterdam Newsroom +31 20 504 5000
